name: preset dropdown OPEN (label.factory on every factory row — .preset-dropdown-menu is display:none until #preset-name-display is clicked, and the rows are built by buildPresetDropdown at runtime, so no resting state can show them). FIRST on purpose: its click handler calls stopPropagation, so the document-level dismiss never fires and the menu stays up while the states below open the popover as well.
settings popover OPEN (label.language, label.hoverHelp and the ui.off face of the toggle are all inside a [hidden] panel, so the gate never measures them at rest)

hover help ON (the ui.on face of the settings toggle, which no resting state shows — the layer starts off). A real click on the real control, inside the popover the previous state opened: the popover's dismiss handler ignores a press on its own subtree, so the panel is still up.
